title: Lancer Enhanced Nuclear Cavalier
description: Automates the two Danger Zone triggers of the Nuclear Cavalier talent in the LANCER system: Aggressive Heat Bleed (rank 1, +2 Heat on your first attack roll this turn while in the Danger Zone) and Fusion Hemorrhage (rank 2, converts Kinetic/Explosive to Energy and adds +1d6 Energy bonus damage on your first ranged or melee attack roll this turn while in the Danger Zone). Danger Zone status is checked as of the start of that attack, so a weapon whose own self-heat pushes the mech into the Danger Zone doesn't trigger until the mech's next attack (a world setting can restore the old same-shot behavior for tables that prefer it). Does not touch rank 3 (Here, Catch!), which the system already handles.
